title: The Beautiful People chase Knockouts control
summary: Angelina Love, Velvet Sky and Madison Rayne mix intimidation and interference with championship ambition. Their rise brings them into conflict with Awesome Kong, Taylor Wilde and newcomer Tara.

chapters.title: Angelina wins her first championship
chapters.result: Angelina Love defeats Awesome Kong and Taylor Wilde in a cage to win the Knockouts title.
chapters.context: The Beautiful People gain the division’s top prize, giving their bullying act tangible power.

chapters.title: Angelina takes the title back from Tara
chapters.result: Angelina Love defeats Tara to regain the Knockouts championship.
chapters.context: Tara’s challenge to the group reaches a controversial finish when the referee misses her foot under the rope.
